items.text: Understand what crontab is and why it is used for task automation
Know the 5 fields in a crontab expression and their order (minute, hour, day-of-month, month, day-of-week)
Understand what an inode is and how Linux separates file names from file data
Know the difference between a hard link and a soft link
Understand what wget and curl are and when to use each
Write crontab expressions for common schedules (daily, weekly, every N hours, every N minutes)
Use crontab -e, crontab -l, and crontab -r commands correctly
Set EDITOR=nano to use nano for crontab editing
Create a hard link using ln and verify shared inode with ls -li
Create a soft link using ln -s and identify it in ls -l output
Use wget to download a file from a URL
Use curl to fetch a URL, call an API, and send a POST request with JSON body
Answer questions about crontab field order and * vs specific values
Identify crontab expressions for specific schedules (e.g., 0 2 * * * = 2 AM daily)
Explain the difference between hard links and soft links for exam scenarios
Know that hard links survive original file deletion but soft links break
Explain AWS EventBridge's use of cron syntax for cloud automation
